narrative.overview: BreakBite combines the warmth of a familiar campus food counter with the precision of an operating timetable. Warm paper and food photography keep the system approachable; deep green structure, orange actions and fine timing marks make it fast to scan under time pressure. Information density is deliberate: preparation, location, dietary state, price and action should be comparable without turning the interface into a generic marketplace grid. The visual world is flat, practical and specific to campus life. It rejects decorative hero sections, excessive floating cards and unsupported promotional claims.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ivory ground with deep green structure and sparse orange action color.
Dense, hairline-separated registrations rather than card collections.
Preparation time expressed as a shared visual scale and tabular figures.
Food imagery and plain language balancing the technical timing grammar.
Safety and sample-data states visible at the point of choice.

rules.name: The Orange Means Action Rule
rules.body: Use orange for actions, timing marks and the logo accent; do not flood large surfaces with it.

rules.name: The Safety Stays Visible Rule
rules.body: Dietary tags, declared allergens and unknown states remain legible on desktop and mobile.

rules.name: The Number Before Noun Rule
rules.body: Preparation minutes and prices use tabular numerals and lead their supporting units or labels.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tonal layering at rest; shadows indicate hover or pinned layers, not decoration.

dos: Do open food-finding surfaces on the task, filters and comparable meal data.
Do keep preparation figures, locations, prices and dietary states scannable together.
Do use Warm Paper, Campus Green and Pickup Orange as the recognizable BreakBite world.
Do keep mobile controls comfortable and basket checkout actions reachable with long orders.
Do use real food imagery with truthful sample and provenance labels.
donts: Don't reintroduce a decorative marketing hero above the ordering task.
Don't turn every result into an isolated rounded card or add shadows without a state purpose.
Don't hide allergen, unknown or sample-menu states on narrow screens.
Don't invent nutrition, certification, availability or waiting-time claims.
Don't use orange as a broad background treatment; its scarcity makes actions clear.
